Rapper Rick Ross, whose real name is William Leonard Roberts, was arrested by Miami Beach police early Thursday morning on felony battery by strangulation and misdemeanor battery charges.

The charges stem from an alleged late August domestic violence incident at his Star Island residence, which was officially reported to law enforcement on September 29. According to police affidavits, an alleged victim accused Ross of physical abuse. Investigators also reviewed surveillance footage from the home showing a friend arriving to pick the woman up being turned away, which Ross later posted about on social media.

Following his arrest, Ross was booked into the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center in Miami-Dade County, where his bond was set at $6,000. He posted bail and was released later Thursday morning. Through his legal counsel, Ross maintains his innocence, entering a not guilty plea and calling the allegations false. An arraignment hearing is scheduled for October 22.
